purpose: Prospective follow-up after observing P030: separate decision-relevant forecasts from a matched administrative information package and test option presentation order. Not a replication independent of prior findings.
primaryEstimands: forecast minus length_control willingness, averaged over all eight settings and two orders
forecast minus geometry willingness, averaged over all eight settings and two orders
secondaryEstimands: decline_first minus participate_first within each information condition
difference of forecast-control contrast across option orders
analysis: Complete-block means; 5000 block-bootstrap percentile resamples, seed 2026112002. Pointwise descriptive 95% intervals; no p-values, power/equivalence claim, independent-person claim or historical pooling. Ten blocks give limited interval stability. All valid free choices retained regardless of reason quality.
control: Fixed unrelated printed catalogue records. Artificial administrative numbers follow decimal-shape distributions but do not encode the forecast values. Match entire user-message o200k_base proxy tokens to within one; character ratio .90-1.10 and lexical-word ratio .75-1.25. Proxy is not established as the provider tokenizer. Actual returned prompt-token counts audited without post-outcome editing. One control topic only, so residual semantic and attention effects remain.
counterbalance: Reverse both explicit action enumerations in COMMON; keep action codes, system role, JSON schema, remaining prose and model constant. Tests presentation-order sensitivity, not all semantic/social-desirability bias.
qualification: Previous successful diagnostic records are context only, not a claim that the new control or current provider passed a fresh semantic gate. New software tests check matching, counterbalance, scheduling and strict parsing before dispatch. No correctness labels are assigned to free choices.

transport.failureRule: Stop on first HTTP/network/unknown-result/schema/refusal/model-identity/duplicate-ID/source-drift error. Preserve partial data; no automatic rerun, refill or resumption. Valid weak explanations do not trigger stopping.

pricing: Uses the existing configured OpenAI API credential and frozen requested model. No free-model substitution. Token ceilings are not a dollar-price promise.
